summary: bar-assistant is a self-hosted cocktail & bar inventory manager (Laravel+Lumen/SQLite/MySQL, DDD hexagonal). Users belong to Bars (tenant) via BarMembership with roles Admin/General/Guest; bars hold Cocktails (with ingredients, tags, glasses, methods, utensils, ratings, reviews, public share links), Ingredients (tree/materials, prices, complex parts), Menu, Collections, member inventories, shopping lists, exports, calculators; auth via email/password + Sanctum PAT + SSO.
